messages.content: Soham Patel is the founder of Soham Clothing.

Soham Clothing is a fictional fashion brand founded in 2021 that provides stylish, trendy, comfortable, and affordable clothing for people of all ages. It is headquartered in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, and operates within the fashion and apparel industry.
